notes:
WHAT CHANGED IN THIS REBUILD (read first). The previous version of this file was written against a stale catalogue. It advertised a five-SKU 'VTEK' PPF and tint range whose landing pages 404 today, and it stated specifications that appear nowhere on the live site: '8.5 mil Polycarbonate TPU', '10-Year Manufacturer Warranty', 'VTEK Solar Armor', 'Iconic and Indulge series', '65% TSER', '99% UV Rejection', '10-Year e-Warranty Film', and the Arabic 'multiple VLT grades' line. All of it is gone. The live film range is exactly TWO products - vertek-ppf-weather-armor and vertek-window-tints - and the PPF and window-film ad groups now point at those two URLs and say only what those two pages say. Do not re-add a number of any kind (mil, micron, TSER, IR, UV, VLT, warranty years) to these two ad groups without a live page that states it. The other three ad groups per language (wholesale hub, become-a-dealer, bulk shampoo) are carried over from the previous file with only the brand-token fix below.

BRAND TOKEN. Ad TEXT says Vertek everywhere, matching the deployed product data and the Google Business Profile. The 'vtek' and 'v-tek' spellings survive only as KEYWORDS, in both languages, to catch buyers who met the other spelling in the market. If the site is ever changed to 'VTEK', the ad text has to change with it or the ad/LP mismatch becomes a misrepresentation flag.

NO TINT LEGALITY CLAIM - DELIBERATE. The live tint page carries a Qatar-compliance line and the previous file leaned on it. It is not used here. Qatar restricts front-glass tint, public sources disagree on the current limit, and this campaign runs in six countries where the rules differ. An ad implying a film is street legal exposes a trade buyer's own customer to a fine. Both tint ad groups sell heat and glare comfort and 'a range of shades' instead, and every legality query (tint law, legal tint, tint limit, tint permit, تصريح تظليل, نسبة التظليل, التظليل المسموح, مخالفة/غرامة تظليل) is a negative in the ad group AND in the shared list. Do not reinstate the compliance line for a GCC-wide ad.

SERVICE LANGUAGE. ABK sells product and performs no installation, tinting, coating, polishing or detailing. No ad promises fitting, booking or an appointment. Because this campaign's audience does its own application, the ads deliberately use 'We Supply, You Fit', 'Supply for PPF Installers', 'Trade Rolls for Detailers' and 'Window Film for Installers' - every one of those assigns the work to the BUYER. That framing is correct here and must NOT be copied into the B2C campaigns. The Arabic side avoids تركيب entirely, even buyer-assigned: 'نورد الفيلم فقط وفنيو ورشتك هم من ينفذون العمل' says the same thing without the token, so an Arabic reviewer scanning for تركيب finds nothing in ad text.

NO PHONE NUMBER, NO PRICES. No ad text contains a phone number - the previous file broke this and Google disallows it. The number belongs in a Call asset at campaign level. The CTA everywhere is 'message us on WhatsApp'. No ad states a price, discount, 'best price' or 'sale'; the site publishes no prices and the offer is a wholesale list delivered over WhatsApp. 'Trade Price List on WhatsApp' / 'أسعار الجملة على واتساب' names the mechanism only and is the single asset family containing the word price - confirm it is acceptable.

SCOPE AND GEO. This file is the B2B wholesale / dealer-recruitment theme only. Geo is six countries (Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), so the Qatar-only geo-leakage negatives used by the B2C themes (dubai, riyadh, kuwait, bahrain, muscat, jeddah, dammam) MUST NOT be applied here - they would block this campaign's core markets. Set location options to 'Presence: people in your targeted locations', not 'presence or interest', or Indian and Pakistani research traffic leaks in.

SHARED NEGATIVES - three deliberate omissions. (1) The bare words 'service' and 'services' are NOT in the shared list even though ABK performs none: the legal name is 'ABK Trading & Service', so an account-level 'service' negative would kill brand search if a brand campaign is ever added. Service intent is blocked by specific phrases instead. (2) The Arabic phrase 'تظليل سيارات' is NOT a shared negative - it is a substring of the AR window-film ad group's best keyword 'رول تظليل سيارات'. Only the service collocations (تركيب تظليل, محل تظليل, تظليل متنقل) are blocked. (3) The bare word 'مركز' is never used: Google Ads ignores Arabic diacritics, so مركز (centre) and مركّز (concentrate) collapse to one token and a bare negative would suppress 'شامبو سيارات مركز', a core B2B shampoo query. Only full phrases (مركز تلميع) are blocked. Likewise 'وكيل' is negative because in Gulf car context it means a vehicle dealership agent, not a distributor.

MATCH TYPES. All positive keywords are Phrase or Exact - no broad, no legacy '+' modified broad. All negatives, ad-group and shared, are listed as Broad in this file; add them in Google Ads as PHRASE match. 'armor all' in particular must be phrase - as a broad negative it would block 'Vertek PPF Weather Armor'. 'noon' must be phrase for the same reason. Google does not apply close-variant matching to negatives, so 'installation' will not block the intentional positive 'ppf film supplier for installers'.

JUDGEMENT CALLS A REVIEWER SHOULD DOUBLE-CHECK.
1. 'We Supply, You Fit' (EN, both film ad groups) is the one place an English ad contains a fitting verb, assigned explicitly to the buyer. It is the strongest differentiator ABK has. If the reviewer wants zero tolerance, swap for 'We Supply, You Apply', already used in the EN wholesale ad group, with no loss of coverage.
2. GCC supply is claimed because public/llms.txt states wholesale across the GCC. No asset promises shipping, lead times or delivery, because cross-border fulfilment is not verified in the repo. Confirm ABK actually ships cross-border before spending in the five non-Qatar markets; if it does not, cut locations to Qatar and drop the ...uae / ...saudi arabia / ...kuwait / ...bahrain keywords in every ad group.
3. 'Made in Canada' appears only in the Briller wash-chemicals ad group, whose landing page is the Briller SKU. It must never drift onto an Autotriz (Germany) or Vertek asset.
4. Friday is paused because the store is closed and the conversion is a human WhatsApp reply. This costs UAE and Saudi reach: the UAE business week is Mon-Fri and Saudi's weekend is Fri-Sat. If the owner will answer WhatsApp on Fridays, unpause Friday for this campaign only - it is the one campaign where the buyer is at work on a Friday.
5. Bid strategy is 'Maximize conversions' for consistency with the sibling campaigns, but this campaign starts with zero conversion history and very low volume. Recommend Maximize clicks with the per-ad-group max CPC caps for the first 30 days, then switch once 15-30 WhatsApp conversions have accrued.
6. 'Resell PPF, Tint & Ceramic' (EN dealer ad group) is accurate - Vertek covers PPF and tint, Autotriz covers ceramic - but it is the one headline spanning three categories against a hub landing page. Fine as written; do not narrow it to a SKU.
7. Keyword-only exposure to terms the pages do not support: 'self healing ppf film supplier' IS supported (the page says self-healing nano-technology), but 'heat rejection window film supplier' leans on a page that says only heat-rejecting - fine - while nothing in either film ad group bids on tpu, mil, ceramic-tint or nano-ceramic terms any more. Those were removed on purpose. Resist adding them back for volume.

PRE-LAUNCH. (a) Verify all four film landing URLs return 200 before import; the two vertek-* slugs replace five dead vtek-* slugs from the previous file, and a 404 Final URL is an instant disapproval. (b) Force a Google re-crawl of /en/b2b and /ar/b2b - the index still carries stale copy naming Insta Finish and Getsun, which the owner has pulled. An ad group whose landing page names a discontinued brand is an avoidable disapproval. (c) Final URLs must be an abktradingservice.com page carrying the WhatsApp button - a wa.me link cannot be a Final URL. Add a Call asset at campaign level for the phone number, plus a Location asset and Business Hours reflecting Sat-Thu 10:00-13:00 and 16:00-22:00, Friday closed. (d) Proof every Arabic asset in a real RTL preview, not a code editor: no headline starts with a Latin token or a digit, no terminal punctuation, no em-dash, no brackets around Latin tokens, Western digits only, tashkeel stripped. Pay particular attention to the five assets that embed a Latin brand token mid-string (منتجات Autotriz و Vertek, وزع أفلام Vertek للحماية, فيلم حماية الطلاء Vertek, أفلام تظليل Vertek, منتجات Briller الكندية). (e) Google Shopping and Merchant Center do not support Qatar but do support UAE, Saudi, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman, so a feed play is possible on the B2B side only if cross-border fulfilment is confirmed (see call 2).

NOT COVERED HERE. A detailer-grade compounds and ceramic trade ad group (Autotriz Heavy Cut 901, Power Cut 701, ION+, REVO, 3D Matrix) is the strongest expansion: Autotriz brand terms are cheap, high-intent and genuinely professional-audience. Left out to keep this campaign at five single-theme ad groups per language, and because those SKUs are already carried by the polish-compound and ceramic themes on the B2C side. A second candidate is Autotriz PPF Gel plus the masking tape - true installer consumables that this campaign's film audience buys on every job.
